turns.answer:
For swimming headphones under $100, I recommend bone-conduction headphones with built-in MP3 storage. They let you listen to music underwater without carrying a phone, while keeping your ears open.

The most important features are:

IPX8 waterproofing — suitable for swimming and submersion.

Built-in MP3 storage — ideally 8GB or more.

Secure fit — especially during flip turns and freestyle.

Physical buttons — easier to operate with wet hands.

One important detail: Bluetooth doesn't work reliably underwater, so you need headphones that can play music directly from their internal storage.
